summary.text: Brennan Barrington is the Libertarian Party nominee for Ohio's 15th Congressional District. He holds an aerospace engineering degree from Ohio State University and is a member of the Libertarian Party of Ohio's Central Committee. In his survey he lists cutting taxes, spending and regulations and changing how elections are conducted among his campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Says he was born and raised in central Ohio and has lived there for all but two years of his life.
Graduated from Licking Heights High School and earned a Bachelor of Science in aerospace engineering from Ohio State University in 2019.
Describes himself as an advocate for electoral reform since the 2016 elections.

Has twice been a delegate to the Libertarian National Convention, once serving on its Platform Committee, and is a member of the Libertarian Party of Ohio's Central Committee, according to his survey.
Advanced unopposed from the May 5, 2026 Libertarian primary, receiving 489 votes.
